name: Campaign Planning
description: Design and run a measurable communications or marketing campaign from audience and objective through message testing, channel plan, production, launch, and learning.

tasks.name: Define campaign objective
tasks.objective: Specify the behavior or outcome sought, target audience segments, baseline, timeframe, constraints, exclusions, budget, ethical/legal requirements, and measurable success indicators.

tasks.name: Develop audience and message insight
tasks.objective: Use research, customer/community evidence, prior performance, and competitive context to identify motivations, barriers, credible proof, objections, language, and channel habits.

tasks.name: Build campaign strategy
tasks.objective: Define positioning, message hierarchy, offer or call-to-action, channel roles, content system, sequencing, targeting rules, measurement plan, budget allocation, and decision thresholds.

tasks.name: Pretest messages and assets
tasks.objective: Test risky claims, comprehension, creative variants, landing flows, tracking, accessibility, brand/legal requirements, and audience fit before committing full spend.

tasks.name: Launch and optimize
tasks.objective: Deploy according to the plan, verify tracking and delivery, monitor quality and outcome metrics, diagnose underperformance, and change only with documented hypotheses.

tasks.name: Publish campaign learning
tasks.objective: Report outcomes against baseline and goals, spend efficiency, segment/channel differences, failed assumptions, confounders, reusable assets, and specific next experiments.
